description: Each case runs the checker over a fixture folder and compares the JSON on stdout, byte structure and all, against the expected file.

cases.name: clean
cases.covers: valid headings, no Misc entries, no unknown categories, version-descending sort

cases.name: messy
cases.covers: missing heading with version recovered from the filename, a Misc entry surfaced for judgment, an unknown category (Deprecated) counted in the Other column
